title: FirstRunChecklistItem
description: OUTPUT-ONLY. One row of the operator first-run checklist (PRP-45): whether a platform component is configured, with a machine reason and a documentation path when it is not complete. complete carries no reason; every other status carries one, so the console can say why a component is missing, disabled or failing instead of showing a blank.

component.description: Runtime component the item checks (runtime status component name, for example cosmos, copilot, search).

required.description: true when the platform cannot serve its core function without this component.
